title: Novalist quality audit

findings.title: The AI context picker omits project data that the send path adds anyway

evidence.detail: Send prepends selected blocks; preview shows only those blocks.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/ChatWebViewController.cs:57

evidence.detail: The first send independently appends all entity summaries to the system prompt.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/ViewModels/AiChatViewModel.cs:166

evidence.detail: Raw entity loads bypass the SDK's AI inclusion filtering.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/ViewModels/AiChatViewModel.cs:224

evidence.detail: The SDK explicitly distinguishes raw entity loads from privacy-filtered GetAiContextAsync.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Sdk/Services/IExtensionEntityService.cs:36

findings.trigger: Send a first chat message with no Context items selected, including a project with entities marked never include in AI.
findings.impact: Names, roles, types and some custom field values enter the provider request despite the empty picker/preview. With a cloud provider, this is an unintended disclosure of project details; it is not a claim that every entity body is sent.
findings.recommendation: Assemble one authoritative request for preview and send. Respect per-entry/per-section exclusions and remove the legacy automatic roster from the chat path.
findings.validation: Capture a fake provider request with the picker empty and an excluded entity. Assert its unique marker appears in neither system nor user messages; preview should account for every context block.

findings.title: Character knowledge caches can write one project's data into another

evidence.detail: The lifetime cache is keyed only by character ID.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/CharacterKnowledgeService.cs:27

evidence.detail: The output directory is resolved from the currently open project on every access.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/CharacterKnowledgeService.cs:37

evidence.detail: A cache hit returns before reading the current project's file.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/CharacterKnowledgeService.cs:48

evidence.detail: Save writes cached character data under the current project root.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/CharacterKnowledgeService.cs:88

findings.trigger: Open two copies/forks of a project that preserve character IDs, loading knowledge in A before switching to B and updating that character.
findings.impact: B can receive A's cached scene knowledge. Distinct project roots are not sufficient isolation because the cache key ignores them.
findings.recommendation: Key cached records and locks by canonical project identity plus character ID; capture that identity for the whole read-modify-write operation and invalidate on context changes.
findings.validation: A fake host with switchable project roots should load different knowledge for the same character ID and never write A's marker to B. Include a delayed write spanning a switch.

findings.title: Character knowledge scans deadlock while saving their first result

evidence.detail: ApplyRecordAsync acquires the character's SemaphoreSlim, then calls LoadAsync and UpsertAsync without releasing it.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/CharacterKnowledgeService.cs:267

evidence.detail: On a cold cache, LoadAsync waits on that same non-reentrant semaphore without a cancellation token.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/CharacterKnowledgeService.cs:52

evidence.detail: On a warm cache, UpsertAsync reaches SaveAsync, which also waits on the same already-held semaphore.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/CharacterKnowledgeService.cs:90

evidence.detail: The existing knowledge scan awaits ApplyRecordAsync after obtaining each scene-analysis record.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/AiAssistantExtension.cs:480

findings.trigger: Run the character knowledge scan with at least one selected character and one nonempty scene for which analysis produces a record.
findings.impact: The scan cannot finish its first knowledge update. Both cold-cache and warm-cache probes remained pending after a watchdog deadline and after caller cancellation; no file writes occurred. Further operations for the locked character can also stall. The probe used fake host/files and made no model request.
findings.recommendation: Acquire the character lock once around the complete read-modify-write transaction; use internal helpers that assume the caller owns it. Pass cancellation to waits and release in finally. Do not simply remove synchronization from the shared cache.
findings.validation: Run knowledge-probe for cold and warm caches. Both cases must complete, write exactly one valid result and release the lock; add overlapping same-character updates and mid-operation cancellation tests.

findings.title: Creating a project with an existing name overwrites its metadata

evidence.detail: CreateProjectAsync uses an existing directory without rejecting it, then saves new project, settings, draft and scene manifests.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/ProjectService.cs:78

evidence.detail: The desktop/mobile creation dialog checks only a nonblank name and location before calling project/create.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/CreateProjectDialog.tsx:48

findings.trigger: Create a project in a parent directory containing a same-name project, including names that sanitize to the same folder.
findings.impact: Existing scene notes and metadata are overwritten without confirmation. Reproduction changed a scenes.json containing 'Irreplaceable notes' into an empty manifest. Shared Core behavior affects desktop and iOS.
findings.recommendation: Validate the normalized project name, exclusively reserve a new destination, and reject any existing project or nonempty destination before writing. Preserve the existing project byte-for-byte on rejection.
findings.validation: Add an actual filesystem regression that creates a project with scene metadata, attempts same-name and sanitized-collision creation, and asserts every original file and the active workspace remain unchanged. Audit harness: existing-project-overwrite.

findings.title: Duplicate book names share the same on-disk draft folders

evidence.detail: The new book's FolderName is only SanitizeFileName(bookName); no unique-folder reservation or collision check exists.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/ProjectService.Books.cs:111

evidence.detail: Folder initialization accepts preexisting folders.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/ProjectService.Migrations.cs:11

findings.trigger: Add a book with a name already used by another book, or a different name producing the same sanitized/case-insensitive folder.
findings.impact: Two independent book records read and write one manuscript. Reproduction opened the 'new' book and saw the original book's chapter. Subsequent edits can cross-contaminate books on desktop and iOS.
findings.recommendation: Assign stable unique storage folders independently of the display name, using the existing draft-folder uniqueness approach and checking the filesystem too.
findings.validation: Create two identically named books with different prose, restart, switch between them and verify independent manifests, files and chapter trees. Audit harness: duplicate-book-folders.

findings.title: Desktop saves overwrite the current file in place

evidence.detail: WriteBytesAsync writes directly into the destination and truncates afterward. A failure during WriteAsync or process termination leaves partial new/old bytes.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/FileService.cs:63

evidence.detail: Settings are also written directly through File.WriteAllTextAsync.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/SettingsService.cs:59

evidence.detail: The iOS coordinated implementation already stages writes and moves them over the destination, providing a local pattern to reuse.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/CoordinatedFileService.cs:18

findings.trigger: App crash, disk-full condition, power loss, or an IO failure while saving a scene, manifest or settings file.
findings.impact: Desktop prose or JSON can become truncated or contain mixed versions. File gates and retries prevent overlapping app writes but do not preserve the previous durable copy. iOS project writes use staging; shared settings still overwrite directly.
findings.recommendation: Write to a unique sibling temporary file, flush, then replace atomically while preserving required Windows hidden attributes and permissions. Keep the prior file intact until the staged write completes.
findings.validation: Inject failures after a partial write and before replacement; assert the original scene/JSON remains intact and retry succeeds. Include hidden-file and cloud-provider attribute tests.

findings.title: A failed backup is listed as a valid recent restore point

evidence.detail: Archive creation writes directly to the final ZIP name and leaves it behind when reading any source file fails.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/ArchiveService.cs:29

evidence.detail: ListFolderAsync trusts timestamp-shaped ZIP filenames without a completion marker or validation.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/BackupService.cs:153

evidence.detail: IsDueAsync uses the newest listed archive, including an incomplete failed archive.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/BackupService.cs:263

findings.trigger: Any project file is locked or unreadable while an automatic/manual backup is being created.
findings.impact: The harness produced an IOException but left a 22-byte ZIP listed as a backup; IsDueAsync then returned false. Failed archives can also consume retention slots and later displace good copies. Desktop and mobile use this archive implementation.
findings.recommendation: Build each archive under a temporary name and publish it only after all files and central-directory writes succeed. Clean up failed staging files and base retention/due checks only on completed backups.
findings.validation: Lock a source file and confirm failure produces no listed restore point, does not defer retry, and does not affect valid retention. Also test failure after some valid entries have been written. Audit harness: failed-backup-is-listed.

findings.title: Apply the same scene exclusions to every export and published site

evidence.detail: Reads every scene returned by the host; checks chapter selection only.
evidence.label: novalist-extension/Novalist.Extensions.Formats/Services/Manuscript.cs:69

evidence.detail: Manuscript publishing reads every scene with no inactive/excluded filter.
evidence.label: novalist-extension/Novalist.Extensions.Publish/PublishExtension.cs:352

evidence.detail: SDK GetScenesForChapter returns the entire manifest list.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Backend/Extensions/HostServices.ProjectAccess.cs:141

evidence.detail: Built-in compilation excludes Inactive and ExcludeFromExport scenes.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Core/Services/ExportService.Compile.cs:103

evidence.detail: Extension export context does not expose the compiled, filtered scene set.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Sdk/Models/ExportFormatDescriptor.cs:46

findings.trigger: Mark a scene inactive or excluded from export, then export the chapter using Formats or generate a manuscript website.
findings.impact: Passages the writer deliberately withheld can be included in the shared file. Changing format changes the privacy boundary.
findings.recommendation: Pass a canonical filtered manuscript snapshot to contributed exporters, or expose and consistently enforce the same scene eligibility rules in Formats and Publish. Reuse core compilation decisions.
findings.validation: Create a chapter with public, inactive and export-excluded scenes; assert that built-in export, every Formats export, and Publish contain only the public scene.

findings.title: Escape HTML attributes in published links and cover metadata

evidence.detail: A Markdown URL is interpolated directly into a double-quoted href.
evidence.label: novalist-extension/Novalist.Extensions.Publish/Site/Markup.cs:237

evidence.detail: Escape replaces ampersand and angle brackets but leaves quotes.
evidence.label: novalist-extension/Novalist.Extensions.Publish/Site/Markup.cs:303

evidence.detail: Cover alt interpolates the same incompletely escaped book title.
evidence.label: novalist-extension/Novalist.Extensions.Formats/Writers/TextWriters.cs:78

findings.trigger: Publish a Codex section containing [reader](https://example.invalid/"onmouseover="window.name=123), or export HTML with a crafted title and a cover.
findings.impact: The generated standalone HTML contains an event-handler attribute. Pasted/imported text can become active browser code when someone opens the shared output.
findings.recommendation: Use context-specific attribute encoding, retain the URL scheme allowlist, and treat link destinations as data. Apply the same encoding to language, cover alt and every other interpolated attribute.
findings.validation: The source-linked probe generated an anchor with literal onmouseover="window.name=123". Add malicious quotes/entity/URL tests and a browser assertion that dispatching mouseover cannot execute supplied code.

findings.title: Remove stale generated pages safely when publishing again

evidence.detail: Writes the new list into the selected folder without tracking or removing prior generated files.
evidence.label: novalist-extension/Novalist.Extensions.Publish/PublishExtension.cs:254

findings.trigger: Generate Everything, then regenerate World into the same folder; similarly remove a sensitive entry or shorten the manuscript.
findings.impact: Old chapter/entry files remain in the folder although the new index no longer links to them. Zipping or uploading that folder can disclose content the writer now intended to omit. A cancelled run also leaves a mixture of versions.
findings.recommendation: Stage a complete generation, maintain a manifest of files this publisher owns, and replace that set only after success. Remove obsolete owned files while preserving unrelated user files.
findings.validation: The probe wrote a manuscript then World-only output; chapter-2.html containing the private ending remained. Test scope reduction, renamed/removed entries, cancellation, and unrelated files.

findings.title: Preserve inline action alternatives and suggestion protection through the host

evidence.detail: Definition returns InsertAfterSelection, despite its comment promising a comment.
evidence.label: novalist-extension/Novalist.Extensions.Toolkit/ToolkitExtension.cs:166

evidence.detail: RPC projects only Text, Disposition and Error, dropping Alternatives and AsSuggestion.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Backend/Rpc/ExtensionContribRpc.cs:69

evidence.detail: The editor directly inserts/replaces prose via execCommand.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/public/editor/dictation-bridge.js:108

evidence.detail: AI rewrite results also populate Alternatives and AsSuggestion.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/InlineRewriteService.cs:175

findings.trigger: Use Toolkit Synonyms/Define or an AI action that returns several alternatives or asks for a suggested edit.
findings.impact: Only the first result survives. Synonyms and AI rewrites replace prose immediately rather than presenting the promised alternatives/review step; dictionary definitions are inserted into manuscript text.
findings.recommendation: Carry the complete inline result contract through RPC and renderer; honor AsSuggestion, present alternatives, and route definitions to an informational/comment disposition. Preserve undo and the original range.
findings.validation: End-to-end test Toolkit synonyms, dictionary definition, AI rewrite alternatives and cancellation: original prose stays unchanged until the explicit action appropriate to the returned disposition.

findings.title: Mobile has no lifecycle flush for edits waiting on autosave

evidence.detail: The Window is created without Stopped/Deactivated save wiring.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Mobile/App.cs:7

evidence.detail: No native background lifecycle override is installed.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Mobile/Platforms/iOS/SceneDelegate.cs:7

evidence.detail: Scene autosave waits 2,000 milliseconds.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/stores/projectPersistence.ts:5

evidence.detail: Desktop close flushing depends on onBeforeClose, absent from the mobile shim.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/useWorkspaceWindow.ts:142

findings.trigger: Type and immediately background/lock the app before its debounce fires; the OS later terminates the backgrounded process.
findings.impact: The last edits have no explicit native lifecycle path to flush. File coordination protects a write that has started, but does not start the renderer's pending save. This is a confirmed wiring gap; actual loss timing requires an iPhone/iPad test.
findings.recommendation: Connect scene/window background transitions to the existing pending-write/editor flush, with a bounded native background task and acknowledgement. Preserve a recoverable draft if a provider cannot finish before suspension.
findings.validation: On a real device: type a unique marker, immediately lock or switch away, terminate after backgrounding and reopen. Repeat with cloud-only files, offline mode, research notes and an unresolved conflict.

findings.title: Mobile path repair can redirect an external project to a different local project

evidence.detail: Any stored path containing /Documents/ is eligible for local-container remapping.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Mobile/Services/IosStoredPathResolver.cs:36

evidence.detail: The replacement is accepted when a same-suffix directory exists.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Mobile/Services/IosStoredPathResolver.cs:45

evidence.detail: The candidate is checked for project presence, then its path is persisted; identity is not compared.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Backend/Workspace.Library.cs:50

findings.trigger: An unavailable external project path ends in /Documents/Foo, while the app's own Documents/Foo holds a different project.
findings.impact: The recent-project entry can be silently repointed to the unrelated local project. A container migration heuristic is being applied to paths whose provenance is unknown.
findings.recommendation: Restrict container repair to previously recorded app-owned paths and compare stable project identity before updating recents. Treat external/bookmarked paths separately.
findings.validation: Add resolver tests for old-container paths, external paths with matching suffixes and two distinct project IDs. On-device, upgrade the app and verify genuine container relocation still works.

findings.title: Independent split panes can silently overwrite each other's scene edits

evidence.detail: Each write reads the latest global sceneHashes[sceneId], regardless of the content version loaded by this pane.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/stores/projectPersistence.ts:73

evidence.detail: Successful saves clear exact matching editors but neither synchronize clean sibling HTML nor preserve divergent sibling base hashes.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/stores/projectPersistence.ts:90

evidence.detail: Editing changes only the addressed pane; multiple panes can own different content for one scene.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/stores/projectEditorActions.ts:147

findings.trigger: Open the same scene in two panes; edit and save the first, then edit/save the still-stale second pane.
findings.impact: The second save uses the first save's fresh hash and passes conflict detection while replacing the first pane's changes. Source-level probe executes real persistence code with a checked-write transport and reproduces this.
findings.recommendation: Track expected hash per independent editor buffer, or keep a single shared document model per scene. Refresh clean sibling panes and preserve the original base for divergent dirty panes.
findings.validation: Add a split-pane e2e: edit both independently, flush in both orders, assert both changes survive or a conflict is offered. Probe: node artifacts/audit-2026-10-06/renderer-probes.cjs.

findings.title: Navigating away after a refused save can discard the only unsaved scene buffer

evidence.detail: A conflicted save sets sceneConflict and returns successfully.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/stores/projectPersistence.ts:78

evidence.detail: openSceneIn proceeds after flushPane and replaces the pane with another clean scene.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/stores/projectEditorActions.ts:28

evidence.detail: Decide later clears the conflict payload.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/stores/projectEditorActions.ts:107

findings.trigger: External modification causes a conflict while opening another scene or closing a tab; choose Decide later.
findings.impact: Navigation retires the original dirty editor. The conflict object becomes the only retained local prose, and dismissing it erases that buffer. Unlike successful conflict resolution, this path has not snapshotted the local text.
findings.recommendation: Make flush explicitly report/refuse unresolved conflicts and abort navigation/tab closure. Keep dirty buffers owned by scene until acknowledged or intentionally discarded.
findings.validation: Source-level probe reproduces openSceneIn followed by dismissSceneConflict losing all references to mine. Add e2e for navigation, tab close, and move-to-pane under an external write conflict.

findings.title: Conflict Save is enabled before the diff is ready, allowing an empty replacement

evidence.detail: rows starts empty; the merge request is asynchronous and failure resets rows to empty.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/SceneConflictDialog.tsx:32

evidence.detail: merged() serializes only rows, so no loaded rows means an empty string.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/SceneConflictDialog.tsx:61

evidence.detail: Save is disabled only while applying, not while loading or after a diff error.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/SceneConflictDialog.tsx:150

findings.trigger: Open a conflict and click Save before scenes/mergeRows returns, or after that request fails.
findings.impact: The existing resolution endpoint is called with empty HTML and replaces the scene. Backend snapshots preserve the previous disk version, but do not preserve the original unsaved local version: ResolveAsync receives only mergedHtml and snapshots disk plus the result. A previous conflict's rows can also remain during a subsequent load.
findings.recommendation: Track loading/error/ready state keyed to the conflict identity; clear old rows immediately, ignore stale responses, and allow Save only for successfully loaded rows. Keep a retry action for errors. Preserve both original local and disk conflict inputs in recovery snapshots before any resolution write.
findings.validation: Delay/reject scenes/mergeRows, assert Save disabled and disk unchanged; resolve a second conflict before the first response and assert rows never cross scenes. After any completed resolution, verify both original local HTML and original disk HTML can be independently restored.

findings.title: Research note edits are outside the shared save/close lifecycle

evidence.detail: Title updates local component items and is persisted only on blur.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/library/ResearchEditor.tsx:270

evidence.detail: Markdown content likewise persists only on blur.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/library/ResearchEditor.tsx:328

evidence.detail: Research has no registered pending-write capture/flush or retained failure payload.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/library/researchModel.ts:150

evidence.detail: Unmount destroys the CodeMirror view; cleanup does not invoke onBlur.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/MarkdownEditor.tsx:358

findings.trigger: Type a research note and navigate through a keyboard command/native tab or close the application without a completed blur/save acknowledgement.
findings.impact: Dirty research state may be unmounted without entering the coordinated save drain. A failed void blur save has no retained retry and no dirty protection. Existing scene/Codex buffers have stronger guarantees.
findings.recommendation: Use resource-owned research drafts, register a pending-write flusher, retain failed payloads and show a retryable save error. Flush on unmount and workspace transitions using the existing registry.
findings.validation: Test typing into title and Markdown then immediately invoking navigation/close without clicking outside; inspect reopened disk content. Inject a failed research/save and ensure close is blocked with recoverable draft.

findings.title: Research save responses overwrite newer unsaved edits across the collection

evidence.detail: save(item) replaces the whole local collection with the server's returned list.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/library/researchModel.ts:150

evidence.detail: patchSelected stores edits in that same collection.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/library/researchModel.ts:162

evidence.detail: Lifecycle updates also replace the whole list.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/library/researchModel.ts:271

findings.trigger: Blur/save note A, immediately select/type into B while the response is delayed; or edit a title while an earlier note save is still in flight.
findings.impact: The older server snapshot replaces B's newer local draft (and other concurrent metadata edits). Even serial backend execution cannot protect keystrokes that exist only in the renderer.
findings.recommendation: Merge acknowledgements by resource and revision rather than replacing all drafts. Keep server data separate from dirty fields and serialize/coalesce writes per research item.
findings.validation: Delay A's response, edit B and assert B's draft survives. Repeat same-item title/content and tag/lifecycle combinations; verify both UI and reopened persistence.

findings.title: Markdown undo history crosses research and scalar-field resource boundaries

evidence.detail: CodeMirror history is created once per mounted editor.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/MarkdownEditor.tsx:330

evidence.detail: External value changes are dispatched as ordinary undoable full-document edits.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/shell/MarkdownEditor.tsx:373

evidence.detail: ResearchEditor is reused for selected items without an identity key.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/library/ResearchView.tsx:132

evidence.detail: Scalar EntityDetailFields are also reused across selected records.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/codex/CodexView.tsx:405

findings.trigger: Switch research notes (or scalar Markdown entity fields), then press Undo in the new resource.
findings.impact: Undo can restore the previous resource's complete text into the newly selected item, and normal blur persistence then saves it there. The probe confirms the retained CodeMirror history behavior; the finding is scoped to reused editors, not EntityListsEditor which is keyed per entity.
findings.recommendation: Pass a stable document identity and reset/recreate CodeMirror state/history when it changes. Mark same-resource external synchronization as non-user changes and avoid emitting onChange for such sync.
findings.validation: Probe uses installed CodeMirror history and reproduces cross-document undo. Add UI tests: edit A, select B, undo repeatedly; no text from A may appear in B.

findings.title: Restoring an entity revision leaves aliases, relationships and sections showing stale data

evidence.detail: Restore updates selectedRecord for the current entity.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/codex/EntityHistoryPanel.tsx:24

evidence.detail: Aliases and relationships reload only when selectedId changes.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/codex/EntityListsEditor.tsx:93

evidence.detail: Sections also ignore all record changes for the same owner.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/codex/useEntitySections.ts:57

evidence.detail: The lists component key remains unchanged for a same-entity restore.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/codex/CodexView.tsx:478

findings.trigger: On desktop or the tablet layout, restore a previous revision while the same entity remains selected, then edit one of its displayed lists/sections. The phone drill-down normally unmounts these editors when entering history, so its remount mitigates this particular stale-list path.
findings.impact: The backend restores the old record while the editor retains the pre-restore lists. A later edit sends those stale whole lists back and can undo the restoration. The same issue can hide interview/wizard updates for an existing entry.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish acknowledgements of local drafts from authoritative external replacements. Explicitly reset draft generations after restore/wizard completion, flushing or discarding older pending writes in a controlled order.
findings.validation: Restore a revision with different aliases, relationships and sections; assert immediate UI refresh, then edit one value and reopen to verify the remainder stays restored.

findings.title: An image-only scene is treated as empty when loaded

evidence.detail: setContent replaces isEmptyHtml documents with one blank paragraph.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/public/editor/editor-content.js:35

evidence.detail: isEmptyHtml checks only sanitized textContent, which is empty for images and other meaningful non-text nodes.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/public/editor/editor-content.js:89

evidence.detail: Save capture compares the live empty document to the stored HTML and can persist that replacement.
evidence.label: novalist-official/app/src/renderer/src/views/editor/useEditorSynchronization.ts:16

findings.impact: The image disappears on load because alt text is not textContent. A subsequent content edit or save capture can replace its stored markup with the blank document.

findings.title: AI chat conversations survive a switch to a different project

evidence.detail: Conversation history is instance state and clears only on explicit Clear.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/ViewModels/AiChatViewModel.cs:38

evidence.detail: The system prompt and project roster are built only on the first message.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/ViewModels/AiChatViewModel.cs:68

evidence.detail: Controllers are cached by extension and view, with no project/book component.
evidence.label: novalist-official/Novalist.Backend/Rpc/ExtensionsRpc.cs:206

findings.trigger: Chat about project A, open project B in the same application session, then return to AI Chat and send a message.
findings.impact: The old history and roster can accompany a request about the new project, contaminating answers and sending project A details again.
findings.recommendation: Scope conversation state to project/book identity or explicitly reset it during a coordinated workspace change. Cancel active requests before switching their owning context.
findings.validation: Use two synthetic projects with distinctive markers; switch projects and inspect the next provider request and displayed history. Test an in-flight response during the switch too.

findings.title: Cancellation does not reach every AI provider or model-loading phase

evidence.detail: The model-load semaphore and HTTP calls have no caller cancellation token.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/AiService.cs:334

evidence.detail: Model loading completes before the request's linked token is created.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/AiService.cs:447

evidence.detail: Copilot GenerateAsync receives no caller token.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/AiService.cs:659

evidence.detail: Anthropic GenerateAsync receives no caller token; the client creates its own CTS.
evidence.label: novalist-aiassistant/Services/AiService.cs:723

findings.trigger: Cancel while LM Studio is loading a model, or cancel an extension workflow through its supplied token while Anthropic/Copilot is generating.
findings.impact: The model-load probe remains pending after cancellation. The other two provider paths also disconnect caller cancellation from their underlying operation, so paid/slow work can continue after the workflow is cancelled. The dedicated chat Cancel button additionally calls AiService.Cancel, which mitigates that particular UI path.

An exploratory old-binary run had 3,859 pass/1 fail with verbose output truncated. Both are superseded by the clean current-source escalated suite above; no old-binary result is used as final validation.
All web, node and e2e TypeScript projects passed.

Six isolated source-level defect probes: split overwrite, conflict buffer loss, autosave self-conflict, CodeMirror cross-document undo, mobile source race, mobile cache generation race. Actual source modules with mocked transport/state; not an end-to-end application run.
51 files declare role=dialog; 12 import the shared helper module, but only 3 call useDialogKeyboard for containment. Representative gaps traced; remaining dialogs not automatically classified.
Child process launch was denied with spawn EPERM. Replaced with built-in Node stripTypeScriptTypes and VM; final probes require no build/process launch.

365 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped against current source. ExtensionFolder global override prevented local extension deployment. Existing warnings: unused MessagePosted events and SDK-generated unreachable-code warning.
37 tests passed; no model weights, GPU or network needed.

11 adversarial source-linked probes reproduced publishing attribute injection/reserved collisions/stale pages, multiline CSV loss, Scrivener subtree selection, nested Markdown omission, RTF decoding, continuity revisions/new entries, and image-reference classification.
Fatal model-load failure emits an error without done; the actual worker handler was exercised with mocks.

All six gallery IDs correspond to current local extension manifests. Gallery uses shared novalist-extensions release repository; release workflow packages per-ID ZIP/manifest/README assets. No gallery CI validator exists. Remote release availability was not queried.
All eight source checks passed. Locale check: 0 missing, untranslated, placeholder or spelling failures; dead-key candidates remain advisory.
75 tests passed. Initial sandbox process-spawn failure was resolved by running the same tests with approved execution.
Web assets compiled; bundle-size and mixed static/dynamic import warnings recorded. This is not a native iOS build.
100 passed, 4 skipped. No installed extension was changed. A generated-code CS0162 warning was emitted.
Four isolated probes reproduced empty-choices SSE failure, uncancelled model loading, model-scope restoration race and preview heading collision.
Registry advisory query: 0 production dependency vulnerabilities reported. Does not prove the application has no vulnerabilities.
NuGet reported no vulnerable backend packages in the restored dependency graph.
100/100, 1,638 supported files, 2 unsupported Swift files, three non-fixable function-length warnings. No .aislop/config.yaml was present; no configuration was changed.

The generated Publish link fixture creates an event-handler attribute and executes it on mouseover in headless Chromium. An independent hidden Electron probe rejected an opaque-origin fetch of a synthetic project file; that suspected exposure was excluded from findings.

Cold and warm cache scenarios both remained pending after 500 ms, still pending 250 ms after cancellation, and performed zero writes. Same-lock acquisition was independently traced in source. Clean observations saved in knowledge-probe-results.json; fake host/files, no network/model, extension deployment disabled. An existing generated-code CS0162 warning was emitted.

checks.detail: Read manuscript security-scope picker, native Swift speech and microphone code, iOS/macOS targets/build script, C# AppleSpeechBridge/SystemMicrophone and renderer capture consumer. No Apple toolchain/device execution on Windows.
59 SDK tests passed against the current source.

Headless Chromium verified finding counts, filters, search, expansion, filtered JSON download, deep links, internal anchors, print expansion/restoration and 390px layout. No JavaScript errors, horizontal overflow or network dependencies.

coverageNotes: Current-source Core, Backend, SDK, extension and AI test suites ran on Windows; transport and Speech Python tests also passed. Four AI tests were skipped.
Isolated audit probes use synthetic fixtures and current source; the report specifies which behavior was reproduced and which was traced statically.
No full installed-application Electron e2e sweep, native macOS/iOS build, simulator or physical-device execution was performed. The mobile web bundle was built successfully.
Shared Core findings identify mobile code applicability; they do not establish that every desktop UI entry point is exposed on mobile.
Publishing attribute injection was reproduced in a source-linked generator fixture and its generated event-handler form executed in headless Chromium. No real site was published.
No real model downloads, paid AI requests, GPU inference, live dictionary/web-capture service checks or packaged extension installation were performed.
Backend NuGet and production npm dependency advisory queries reported no known vulnerabilities. This is not a full dependency freshness or security certification.
Legacy Pen & Paper and Qwen3 inspection covered inventory, manifests, dependencies and native contributor compatibility only, not deep feature behavior or builds.
Existing serialized workspace mutations, checked scene writes, coordinated mobile writes, ZIP checks, authenticated import requests and diagnostic redaction were considered when reviewing findings.
Production source, installed extensions, user projects and changelogs were left unchanged. Audit code and logs are isolated in the report directory.
limitations: No native macOS/iOS/device execution. Legacy extension compatibility review only. No production fixes applied.
